select cc.code as code ,cc.code_nm as code_nm from com_code cc where 1=1
and cc.code_type = #{code_type}
and trunc(sysdate) between cc.start_date and nvl(cc.end_date, trunc(to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')))
and not (trunc(sysdate) between cc.start_date and nvl(cc.end_date, trunc(to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd'))))
order by cc.sort_order
